TITLE: Summer 2027 Intern - Forward Deployed Engineer – Global Public Sector 
Location: Remote | Program Duration: 12 weeks 
 About the Role 
Salesforce is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Intern to join a team that builds and deploys AI agent solutions for government, nonprofit, and education organizations. You’ll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You’ll shadow their customer work and own projects that can make a difference for those customers. Structured mentorship is built in.
 The Intern Experience 
 AI-powered development: Build with tools like Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products such as Vibes. 
 Mentorship: Learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems at scale. 
 Behind-the-scenes access: Sit in on customer working sessions and project reviews to see how real solutions are scoped, built, and delivered. 
 Frontier access: Work on Agentforce and Salesforce’s evolving AI platform. Your feedback goes straight to product teams. 
 Curiosity encouraged: Try new AI tools, models, and frameworks, and share what you learn. 
 What You’ll Do 
Shadow Forward Deployed Engineers and Deployment Strategists in customer meetings and working sessions. You’ll learn how business problems become AI solutions. 
Contribute to the build of AI agents that take real actions for real organizations. 
Write and test prompts, and improve how agents reason and use tools. 
Own an intern project, such as a tool, prototype, or internal accelerator, that may be used in customer solutions. 
Help build data pipelines and connect systems using Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks. 
Help build dashboards that track agent performance. 
Build proofs-of-concept that go quickly from idea to working demo. 
Present your work and share ideas with senior engineers and the product team, culminating in a capstone project presentation at the end of the 12-week program. 
 What We’re Looking For 
U.S. citizenship is required, as this role involves work with U.S. Government agencies. 
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
Experience in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and a willingness to learn others. 
Some experience with LLMs and prompt engineering, through class projects, personal projects, hackathons, or prior internships. 
A basic understanding of APIs, databases, and data modeling. 
Relevant coursework, internships, or activities aligned to the skills for this role, such as class or personal projects, hackathons, open source, or student organizations. 
Strong communication skills and comfort working with technical and non-technical teammates. 
Curiosity about AI. You experiment with new tools and models on your own. 
A collaborative, team-first attitude. 
 Nice-to-Haves 
Salesforce Trailhead badges or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist). 
Exposure to agent frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex. 
Experience with cloud data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery. 
Interest in public sector, higher education, or nonprofit work.

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
